Read the complete admission Owner and every product call site. Fixed shapes are private detached snapshots with typed properties and Owner serialization. Selection, ownership, history digest, complete recipient Run/Assistant witnesses, clone provenance and missing/null rejection have a single validator; no dictionary compatibility interface remains. Dynamic storage/Engine consumers use the existing transaction and validated bindings; the public stored schema and error text are unchanged. JSON syntax ownership review: validator calls now target JsonObject. The validator body is AST-identical after expanding its canonical declarations; each consumer AST is identical after normalizing only that call/import, and every original import scope is preserved, including the isolated worker. Record-specific mandatory fields, policy, identity, version, CAS, effects and permission validation are unchanged. ProjectConfig retains a direct public delegate, never a second validator.
